[[File:Kachirho_great_tree_2.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The entrance of the great tree]]
{{Quote|Have you visited the great tree here in Kachirho? There are many prominent figures there - many that can show you the way to high adventure on Kashyyyk.|[[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RotW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Rage of the Wookiees]]''</ref>}}
The '''great tree''' was a massive inhabited [[Wroshyr tree/Legends|wroshyr trees]] that made up the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] city of [[Kachirho/Legends|Kachirho]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> While the city encompassed other inhabited wroshyr trees,<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> and buildings on the ground level,<ref name="SWG:RotW" /> most of the settlement of Kachirho spiraled around the trunk of the 300-meter-tall great tree.<ref name="RotS:TVD" />

During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the tall tree allowed the Wookiees to defend the lagoon area from above.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|190|Kachirho}}</ref>

Wookiees living in the great tree during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] included [[Kymayrr]], [[Chatook]], [[Doctor/Legends|Dr.]] [[Cheyerooto]], [[Harwakokok]] and [[Ovarra]]. Several off-worlders, including [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gurnst]], [[Flash Harrison]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Koh (Twi'lek)|Koh]], [[Fezrik Bendledon]], [[Unluto]], [[Belga Daeri]] and [[Mada Johnson]], visited the tree after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:RotW" />
